Tessera plugin VERSION for Linux (x86-64)
=========================================

In this folder:
  Tessera.clap    the CLAP instrument (Bitwig, Reaper, ...)
  Tessera.vst3    the VST3 instrument (a folder: copy the whole folder)

There is no standalone app on Linux yet.

Install
-------
  mkdir -p ~/.clap ~/.vst3
  cp Tessera.clap ~/.clap/
  cp -r Tessera.vst3 ~/.vst3/

Then rescan the plugins in your DAW. Tessera is an instrument, under "Tessera".

It needs X11 (or XWayland) for its window, and zenity or kdialog for the OPEN and SAVE dialogs.
Built on Ubuntu 24.04: an older distribution may lack a new enough C++ library.

The manual for the plugin: https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
What's in this beta, and what isn't yet: BETA_NOTES.md in this folder.
Found a problem? https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/issues (the plugin's version, your DAW and its
version, the distribution, the steps, what you expected and what happened).
